name: Humanas
verdict: Care provider from Colbitz whose managing shareholders are Ina Kadlubietz and Dr. Jörg Biastoch. Nothing found.
note: Shirt sponsor of 1. FC Magdeburg since 2021-22 (partner since 2016-17). Rating note: none. Humanas names Ina Kadlubietz and Dr. Jörg Biastoch as its two managing shareholders and calls itself a family company (humanas-ownership).
